item.title: MacReport Agent 0.8.1 (28)
item.description: Emergency protection: opt in in settings, hold and confirm to lock your Mac and ask user apps to quit normally. Reports confirmed, pending and declined steps. Adjustable direct Live profiles up to 10, 5 or 2 fps with smaller resolution, measured heartbeat replies and signed automatic-update settings. Use iPhone 0.8.1 (28) for the new controls. Emergency protection remains off until enabled.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.8.1 (26)
item.description: Nearby controller: use your iPhone as a trackpad and action panel on the same local network. Fixed keys, text, brightness, keyboard backlight and audio controls where supported. Enable the local controller in Access on your Mac, then explicitly start control on iPhone 0.8.1 (26). Screen Recording is not required for Nearby; mouse and keyboard input requires Accessibility. Direct Live remains separate.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.8.1
item.description: Clearer cleanup coverage and folder-specific analysis, file details, candidate search, scan progress and recovery totals. Compact status cards, better language switching and ordered layout previews. Pair with iPhone 0.8.1 (24). Direct Live has no hosted relay.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.8.0
item.description: Detailed disk cleanup with caches, old logs, Downloads, installers, large and old files, exact duplicates and a storage breakdown. Review each choice and keep data recoverable. Recognized projects and protected data are excluded. Retries an incomplete zero-work cold scan once. Works with iPhone 0.8.0 (22).

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.7.1
item.description: Customize the overview on each Mac: reorder and hide sections, choose readings and full-width tiles, and restore the default layout. Settings stay local and do not change permissions. English and Russian; Light and Dark appearance.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.7.0
item.description: English and Russian, a compact overview, per-action feedback, event history, alert thresholds and quiet hours. Live viewing starts separately from mouse and keyboard control and reconnects without replaying input. Recoverable cleanup and separately confirmed permanent deletion. TURN fallback supports an owner-configured server; no hosted relay is included.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.6.0
item.description: Direct Live screen viewing and remote control with owner-private iCloud signaling. Requires the local screen/control permissions and an unlocked awake Mac. This first release uses direct connections without a TURN relay; iCloud snapshots remain available for unsupported networks. Faster status updates and clearer widget timestamps.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.5.0
item.description: New bento overview and native sidebar, with Light, Dark and Follow System appearance. Includes agent-originated test push and alerts for repeated power-adapter transitions.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.4.0
item.description: Open installed applications and control an unlocked Mac through direct taps, scroll, encrypted text and fixed keys. Requires a separate local control switch and macOS Accessibility permission.
